name: empty-m
title: Sign up · Empty, before typing
note: The meter's resting state replaces “At least 8 characters.”: four empty segments, no word, and the three guides with open rings.

name: loading-m
title: Sign up · Typing, no score yet
note: The estimator loads on the first keystroke. Until it lands: no word, no lit segment, the third guide stays open. Length and number-or-symbol tick live because they need no estimator.

name: short-m
title: Sign up · Under 8, before the press
note: Under 8 the meter never shows a word, even once the estimator has loaded. The open length ring is the cue; nothing is red before the press.

name: short-press-m
title: Sign up · Under 8, pressed
note: Checked on the device before Clerk, as today: the field goes red and the line takes the slot under the meter. The next keystroke clears it.

name: weak-m
title: Sign up · Weak
note: One segment, quiet ink. Clerk will refuse it, so a line under the guides says what to do. Red is kept for Clerk's answer.

name: weak-email-m
title: Sign up · Weak: built from their email
note: The person's email goes to the estimator as their own words, so a password built from it scores Weak and the third guide stays open. Shown here with Show on so the match is visible.

name: fair-m
title: Sign up · Fair
note: Two segments, still quiet ink: Clerk refuses Fair too. Every guide is ticked, so the line explains what the guides can't.

name: good-m
title: Sign up · Good
note: Three segments in success green: Clerk should accept it. No line.

name: strong-m
title: Sign up · Strong
note: Four segments. A passphrase with spaces leaves A number or symbol open and still reads Strong: the guides advise, only the estimator moves the meter.

name: show-m
title: Sign up · Good, shown
note: Show on with the meter present. Nothing about the meter changes or re-announces; the button shows its pressed state.

name: breached-m
title: Sign up · Clerk refused: breached
note: Clerk's answer after the press, on a password the meter called Good. The meter empties (Clerk's verdict wins), the red line takes the slot under it, the guides stay. Next keystroke clears it and the meter scores again.

name: refused-weak-m
title: Sign up · Clerk refused: too easy to guess
note: Clerk's strength failure on a password the meter called Good. Same pattern as breached.

name: empty-320
title: Sign up · Empty, before typing at 320

name: fair-320
title: Sign up · Fair at 320
note: The longest guide and the Fair line wrap; marks stay top-aligned to the first line.

name: breached-320
title: Sign up · Clerk refused: breached at 320

name: breached-d

name: reset-empty-m
title: Reset · Empty, before typing
note: The same block under New password. The estimator gets the email they typed on the step before.
